note: Proposed by the developer (v0.6.8, extended v0.6.9 and v0.6.13) for the product owner to confirm or change. Gate E-04 stays BLOCKED until status is AGREED with an approver and date. order_allocate = create an outbound order (1-3 lines from the 20 hottest SKUs) + allocate it, measured end to end; half are cancelled again. order_pick = create (1-2 hot lines) + allocate + read + pick every line into one shared packing node, half unpicked back to a bin, measured end to end (4-7 requests). reconciliation = routine (ledger totals); reconciliation_full = deep (sums the whole ledger).

smoke.description: Fast sanity run (CI-sized): small catalogue, few users

representative.description: One busy auto-parts distribution warehouse: 20 000 SKUs, 1 000 bins, 100 000 stock positions, 25 concurrent operators/tablets

stress.description: Representative dataset at more than twice the concurrency (60 virtual users) to see how latency degrades; reported, never enforced

ledger-growth.description: Representative dataset plus 10 000 000 synthetic historical ledger rows (net-zero pairs over the last 365 days) to show the effect of a large ledger on reads, writes, reconciliation and exports
